title: Lock Desk Service Standard: Confirmation Lag Pricing — Builder Extended Rate Lock
content:
The time a Builder Extended Rate Lock request waits before the lock desk confirms it is reflected in the locked rate.

**Standard.** The confirmation lag is the calendar days from the lock request date to the confirmation date. A lag above 3 days adds 0.0625 points; a lag of 2 days up to 3 days adds 0.03125 points; a shorter lag adds nothing. The points are percentage points of interest rate added to the locked rate before it is held at no less than the par rate and rounded.

| Confirmation lag | Added to the rate |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 day | nothing |
| 2 or 3 days | 0.03125 points |
| 4 days or more | 0.0625 points |

The request date is read from the lock record; the confirmation date is the date the lock is confirmed.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, request 10 June)

| Confirmation date | Lag | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 11 June | 1 | nothing |
| 12 June | 2 | 0.03125 |
| 13 June | 3 | 0.03125 |
| 14 June | 4 | 0.0625 |
